scope: Three bounded primary reports were checked for a repeated complete form with independently explicit different object bindings, or incompatible complete names for one explicit referent. This is a local source audit, not a cache-wide absence claim.

candidates.result: The report explicitly says position does not decide which plant, whether it names a plant, or that it has any plant owner; no connector, bracket, or cross-reference was observed (lines 13-17). Thus this is one form with a proximity contact, not two explicit object kinds or a fixed-name/reusable-role contrast.
candidates.decision_effect: No proper-name versus reusable-attribute decision changes.

candidates.physical_binding: A written material patient precedes a state-only checkpoint and a deictic target action in one source sequence; this is an action/state relation, not two independently depicted object bindings.
candidates.result: The report labels the participant assignment a C011 working hypothesis and says it does not verify participant identity (lines 11-13). The German material and action wording are an inherited working gloss, so they cannot supply the requested independent referent contrast.
candidates.decision_effect: The chain does not distinguish a fixed object name from a reusable role.

candidates.literal_forms_loci: Complete okal in f72 ring-E records and f82 P1/P2, with okaly nearby (lines 5-20, 50-54, 72-80).
candidates.physical_binding: The source compares ring and pool drawing records against alleged owners, but after masking complete okal forms owner recovery is 0/3; f82 contacts remain proximity-ambiguous (lines 46-55, 77-80).
candidates.result: The report's system-entry interpretation is explicitly a replaceable working renderer, not confirmed plaintext (lines 5-16). Repeated form and local proximity do not establish either a unique name or a reusable attribute attached to known object kinds.
candidates.decision_effect: No referent-level discriminator is available from these records.

conclusion.smallest_decisive_observation: A future source-bound packet must contain either the same exact complete form attached by an explicit connector/bracket/label relation to two independently identified object kinds, or one explicitly identified referent carrying two incompatible complete forms. Nearest-owner proximity and analyst glosses do not satisfy this.
conclusion.reopening_condition: Preserve the three reports and reopen only if such an explicit binding is already available in an admitted source; no new image, TSV, or rerun was used here.
